the first session of the 16<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabha.

Further discussion on the motion of
thanks on the President’s Address moved by Shri Rajiv Pratap Rudy and seconded
by Shri Ramvilas Paswan (Discussion concluded).

records.title:
Regarding proposed withdrawal of some companies of Central Forces from West
 Bengal.

Presentation of the 263<sup>rd</sup>
Report of the Standing Committee on Human Resource Development on the
Functioning of Indira Gandhi National Open University.

Need to take
necessary steps for time-bound completion of Kollam bye-pass in Kerala.
Need to sanction financial assistance to Maharashtra for organizing Kumbh Mela in Nasik.

Need to allocate Coal blocks to Odisha state PSUs
for industrial transformation of the State.

Need to reconstruct the bridge on National Highway 
in district Howrah, West Bengal.
Need to provide a permanent stoppage of Senthur Express (Train No. 16735-36) at Cuddalore Thirupapuliyur railway station in Tamil Nadu.

Need to provide stoppage of train Nos. 12605 and
 12606 (Pallavan Express) and 16101 and 16102 (Rameswaram Express) at Keeranur
Railway Station in Tamil Nadu.

Need to include Tangsa, Nocte, Tutcha, Wangchoo and
 Yubin tribes of Arunachal Pradesh in the list of Scheduled Tribes.

Need to start construction
 of Delhi-Meerut Express Highway.

Need to undertake repair of
stretch of National Highway No. 30 between Patna and Maner in Bihar.

Need to repeal Article 370 
of the Constitution.

Need to set up a
bench of Himachal Pradesh High Court at Kangra district headquarters in the
State.

Need to undertake
re construction of damaged roads and rehabilitate people affected by flood and
landslide that rocked Uttarakhand in 2013.

Need to convert the National Highway No. 222 
(Mumbai-Vishakhapatnam) passing through Ahmednagar Parliamentary Constituency
in Maharashtra into four lane.

Need to restore services of various trains in Jalaun 
Parliamentary Constituency in Uttar Pradesh.

Need to accord approval to the proposal for providing road
connectivity to agricultural fields in Maharashtra to ensure easy procurement
of agricultural produce.

Need to frame a National Crop Insurance Scheme
 providing a better insurance cover to farmers in the country.

Need 
to give environmental clearance for construction of sluice gate in North Koel
Irrigation Project in Bihar.

Madam Speaker on behalf of the House congratulated Miss Malavath Purna a class IX student for becoming the youngest female climber to scale the Mount Everest.  Purna was accompanied by another teenager, Sadhanapalli Anand Kumar.
Papers laid on the Table of the House by Ministers/members.

The Speaker made reference to the passing away of Shri A.
Narendra, member, 13<sup>th</sup> and 14<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabhas.

Shri Dinesh Trivedi, member representing
 Barrackpur Parliamentary Constituency of West Bengal took oath in English,
signed the Roll of Members and took his seat in the House.

The Minister of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises made
certain clarifications regarding speech made by his party Member Shri Prataprao
Ganpatrao Jadhav.

Announcement regarding amendments to the motion of thanks on 
President’s Address.

Discussion on 
the Motion of Thanks on the President’s Address moved by Shri Rajiv Pratap Rudy
and seconded by Shri Ramvilas Paswan (Discussion not concluded).

records.title:
Shri Shibu 
Soren took the oath or made the affirmation signed the Roll of Members and took
their seats in the House.

Need to take necessary steps to arrange
land for Kendriya Vidyalaya in Banka Parliamentary constituency, Bihar.

Need to provide a special financial
 package to Kerala for rehabilitation and treatment of Endosulfan affected
people in Kasargod district and other parts of the State.

Need to provide compensation to farmers who suffered
damage to their crops due to untimely rains in Osmanabad district of
Maharashtra.

Need to reinstate 
contract-degree and diploma engineers in Paradip Port.

Need for a moratorium on
payment of interest by debt stressed West Bengal.

Need to set up Food Processing Business 
Incubation Centres in all Taluks in Tanjavur district, Tamil Nadu.

Need to set up ECHS Polyclinics in Chamarajanagar Parliamentary Constituency
in Karantaka.

Need to expedite
pending rail and road projects in Assam.
Need to accord the status of I.I.T. to Indian School of Mines, Dhanbad, Jharkhand.

Need 
to expedite construction of roads under Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana in
Fatehpur district of Uttar Pradesh.

Need to resume the Korba-Raipur intercity train service and stoppage of
various trains at Akaltara, Baradwar and Sakti railway stations in
Janjgir-Champa Parliamentary constituency in Chhattisgarh and also expedite
construction of over bridges and level crossing in the constituency.

Need to provide adequate compensation as per the laid down norms to people
 displaced due to acquisition of their land by CCL and BCCL and Bokaro Steel
Plant in Jharkhand.

Need to include all the naxal affected districts of Santhal Pargana in 
integrated Action Plan.

Need to take steps to promote the use of Hindi in Government Offices and 
Departments in the country.

Need to upgrade the
 capacity of mobile telecommunication equipment in Leh & Kargil districts of
Jammu and Kashmir.

Need to take steps to prevent incidents of rape and murder in different
parts of the country.

Need to reduce the gap between the platform and coaches and to take other
safety measures to prevent train mishaps in Mumbai.

Presentation of the 31<sup>st</sup> Report
of the Committee on Urban Development.

Presentation of the 14<sup>th</sup> Report
 of the Committee on Papers Laid on the Table.

Presentation of the 44<sup>th</sup>, 45<sup>th</sup>
and 46<sup>th</sup> reports of the Committee on Labour.

Presentation of
the 46<sup>th</sup> Report on the subject ‘Implementation of Prime Minister’s
New 15 Point Programme of the Committee on Social Justice and Empowerment.

Presentation of
the 59<sup>th</sup>, 60<sup>th</sup> and 61<sup>st</sup> Reports of the
Committee on Agriculture.

Papers laid on the 
Table of the House by Ministers/members.

The Speaker made references to the passing away of shri G. Bhuvarahan, member, 5th and 6th Lok Sabhas; Shri S. Mallikarjuniah, member, 10th, 12th and 14th Lok Sabhas; Shri Ram Dhari Shastri, member, 6th Lok Sabha; Shri Shrish Chandra Dikshit, member, 10th Lok Sabha; Shri Ramnihor Rai, member, 10th Lok Sabha; Shri Umakant Mishra, member, 7th and 8th Lok Sabhas; Dr. N. Janardhana Reddy, sitting member of Rajya Sabha and member of 12th, 13th and 14th Lok Sabhas; Shri Madan Tiwary, member, 6th Lok Sabha; Shri Jayarama I.M. Shetty, member, 12th Lok Sabha; Shri R. Umanath, member, 3rd and 4th Lok sabhas and Shri Tapan Sikdar, member, 12th and 13th Lok Sabhas.  She also made reference to the loss of lives of twenty four students of an engineering college of Hyderabad, drowned in river Beas near Thalot village in Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh on 8 June, 2014.

Regarding 
nomination of the members to the Panel of Chairpersons.

Laid 14 Bills passed by the Houses of Parliament during the 2<sup>nd</sup>
Part of the 15<sup>th</sup> Session of the 15<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabha and
assented to by the President.

Papers laid on the Table of the 
House by Ministers/members.

Announcement 
regarding Amendments to the
 Motion of Thanks 
on President’s Address.

Laid a copy of the President’s Address to both the Houses of
Parliament assembled together on the 9th June, 2014.

Newly elected Members took the oath or made the affirmation,
 signed the Roll of Members and took their seats in the House.

Shri Udayanraje
Pratapsinha Bhonsale and Shri Adhir Ranjan Chowdhury took the oath or made the 
affirmation, signed the roll of Members and took their seats in the House.

The Prime
Minister introduced the Members of the Union Council of Ministers.
Members offered felicitations to the Speaker.

The Minister of Parliamentary 
Affairs, on behalf of the House complimented the Speaker pro tem for the smooth
conduct of business in Lok Sabha.

Motions for Election of the Speaker, moved 
by Shri Narendra Modi and seconded by Shri L.K. Advani (Motion Adopted).

Observation 
regarding notices of motions for Election of Speaker.

Newly elected members of 16<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabha took the oath
or made the affirmation, signed the Roll of members and took their seats in the
House.

Newly elected members of 16<sup>th</sup>
Lok Sabha took the oath or made the affirmation, signed the Roll of members and
took their seats in the House.

Announcement 
regarding making and subscribing an oath or affirmation.

Shri Mulayam Singh Yadav, Shri K. Chandrasekhara Rao and Shri Narendra Modi,
elected Members from Mainpuri, Medak and Vadodara Parliamentary Constituencies
of Uttar Pradesh, Telangana and Gujarat respectively, resigned from their
Parliamentary Constituencies w.e.f 29.05.2014.

records.title:
The 
Speaker pro tem announced that the Hon'ble President nominated Shri Arjun 
Charan Sethi, Shri P.A. Sangma and Biren Singh Engti in Panel of Chairpersons.

The Speaker pro tem 
welcomed all members who have been elected to the 16<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabha.

The Speaker Pro-tem made reference to the passing away of Shri
 Gopinath Rao Munde, member elected to 16<sup>th</sup> Lok Sabha, member, 15<sup>th</sup>
Lok Sabha and Minister of Rural Development, Panchayati Raj and Drinking Water
and Sanitation.

Regarding
 postponement of Oath/Affirmation due to sad demise of Shri Gopinath Mundeji.
Laid a list,  containing the names of Members elected to the Sixteenth Lok Sabha at the General Elections of 2014, submitted to the Speaker by the Election Commission of India.
